# VEFS Foundation

> Valluvam Ecological Farming and Social Welfare Foundation (VEFS Foundation) is a Tamil Nadu-based non-profit Trust founded in 2019 by R. Vetrimaran. It works at the intersection of ecological farming, indigenous biodiversity conservation, and rural community welfare — training farmers, planting native trees, running organic markets, and empowering communities across Tamil Nadu, India.

## Organisation

- **Full name**: Valluvam Ecological Farming and Social Welfare Foundation
- **Short name**: VEFS Foundation
- **Founded**: 2019
- **Founder & President**: R. Vetrimaran
- **Secretary**: K. Rajasekaran
- **Treasurer**: S. Prajana
- **Type**: Non-profit Trust (registered, 80G tax-exempt)
- **Location**: Nilakottai, Dindigul District, Tamil Nadu, India
- **Website**: https://www.vefsfoundation.com

## Mission & Vision

**Mission**: To drive sustainable change through ecological farming, biodiversity conservation, and social welfare, fostering harmony between nature and society.

**Vision**: To create a harmonious world where ecological farming thrives, biodiversity is protected, and communities live with dignity, care, and sustainability.

## Core Focus Areas

1. **Organic & Natural Farming** — Empowering farmers through natural farming techniques and native seed preservation
2. **Biodiversity Conservation** — Protecting and planting indigenous tree species, restoring ecosystems
3. **Social Welfare** — Supporting farmer livelihoods, women's empowerment, and rural community development

## Impact (since 2019)

- 250+ indigenous trees planted and conserved
- 300+ farmers trained annually
- 26,000+ community members reached

## Training Programs

### One Month Intensive Practical Natural Farming Training
- **Duration**: 1 month, daily immersive
- **Format**: In-person, residential
- **Location**: VEFS Training Farm, Nilakottai, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu
- **Capacity**: 10 participants per batch
- **Donation-based fee**: ₹6,000
- **Curriculum**: Land & soil preparation, seeds & nursery management, rain-fed millet cultivation, pest & disease management, animal husbandry, forest & ecology, farm infrastructure, value addition & marketing
- **Eligible**: Aspiring farmers, students, homesteaders, nature enthusiasts (18–60 years)
- **Registration**: Required — [Trainings page](https://www.vefsfoundation.com/trainings.html)

## Events (Recurring)

### Valluvam Organic Market — Adyar, Chennai
- **When**: Every 1st Sunday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- **Venue**: KNRA Hall, Adyar, Chennai
- **Features**: Organic produce, honey, instant mixes, millet lunch
- **Entry**: Free (pre-registration required)
- **Contact**: 7448558447 / 9566667708

### Valluvam Organic Market — Tambaram, Chennai
- **When**: Every 2nd Sunday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- **Venue**: Baby High School, Tambaram West (opposite W1 Police Station, near MR Theater)
- **Features**: Organic vegetables, traditional grains, handloom, cold-pressed oils, clay pots, millet lunch
- **Entry**: Free (no registration needed)
- **Contact**: 7448558447 / 9566667708

## Volunteer Opportunities

### Organic Farm Assistant
- **Duration**: 3 months (full-time or part-time)
- **Location**: VEFS Farm, Nilakottai, Tamil Nadu (on-site, residential)
- **Age**: 18–60 years
- **Spots**: Limited (3–4 per cycle)
- **Benefits**: Hands-on training, certificate, meals, and accommodation provided
- **Apply**: [Volunteer page](https://www.vefsfoundation.com/volunteer.html)
